plugins.name: magpie
plugins.description: Magpie website intelligence over a hosted MCP server. Free: a single-page audit covering overall score, Core Web Vitals, on-page SEO, security headers, robots/sitemap, and WordPress-aware findings. Pro: rank tracking (Google positions and movement over time) and competitor keyword-gap analysis.

skills.name: magpie-audit
skills.description: Audit a website's health with Magpie — overall score, Core Web Vitals, on-page SEO, security headers, robots/sitemap, and WordPress-specific checks. Use when the user wants to audit a site, check if their website is healthy, run an SEO check, understand why a site is slow, or asks "how is my website doing".
skills.description_zh: 使用Magpie审计网站健康，检查总分、Core Web Vitals、页面SEO、安全响应头、robots与sitemap及WordPress特有问题，解释网站慢或健康异常的原因。

skills.name: magpie-seo
skills.description: Track Google rankings and find competitor keyword gaps with Magpie Pro. Use when the user wants to track their rankings, see where they rank for a keyword, ask "am I ranking", find what keywords competitors rank for, or run a keyword-gap analysis.
headings: Magpie SEO — rank tracking & keyword gap
skills.description_zh: 使用Magpie Pro跟踪Google关键词排名，查找竞争对手排名词与自身关键词缺口。
